name: slab spacing
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 相邻轨道板之间的空间间距。
usage_note: 该文考察的100–500 mm只是其参数工况，不能作为通用允许限值。

complete_examples.text: When analysing the effects of slab spacing on the system vibration response, the spacing distance is in the range of 100–500 mm in Section 3.2.

It can be observed from Figure 9 that the maximum responses of all dynamic indices are gradually increased by the increase of the track slab spacing, and the maximum responses are increased by 2.5%, 1.3% and 1.7% for indices of rail displacement, bridge displacement and the wheel-rail force respectively.
